acceptanceCriteria: affected.Build takes a context and stops at a bounded check interval, and a test cancels an impact call mid-walk.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the AFU-V1 S7 review (PR #205, V1-0254), recorded there as a known gap. `affected.Build` takes no context, so a cancelled `corvint.flows.impact` MCP call keeps walking until it finishes.
title: mcp: cancelling corvint.flows.impact does not stop a walk already running
